rationale: C03 is an exceptionally close drafting template: the child reproduces the same two-part structure and nearly verbatim language, substituting the World Meteorological Organization for the South Pacific Commission. C25 and C24 use substantially the same designation-and-non-abridgment formula but contain additional or slightly less exact material.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I hereby designate the World Meteorological Organization as a public international organization entitled to enjoy the privileges, exemptions, and immunities conferred by the said International Organizations Immunities Act.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I hereby designate such Commission as a public international organization entitled to enjoy the privileges, exemptions, and immunities conferred by the said International Organizations Immunities Act.
shared_material.explanation: The operative designation sentence is nearly verbatim, with only the organization reference changed.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The designation of the World Meteorological Organization as a public international organization within the meaning of the said International Organizations Immunities Act is not intended to abridge in any respect privileges, exemptions, and immunities which such organization may have acquired or may acquire by treaty or congressional action.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The designation of the South Pacific Commission as a public international organization within the meaning of the said International Organizations Immunities Act is not intended to abridge in any respect privileges, exemptions, and immunities which such organization may have acquired or may acquire by treaty or congressional action.
shared_material.explanation: The entire non-abridgment provision is reproduced essentially word for word, changing only the named organization and capitalization.
